summary: The OccHealth module is part of the larger HSPnet enrollment system, focusing on managing occupational health requirements for student enrollments. It includes functionalities for displaying, editing, and managing student information related to occupational health compliance.
purpose: To manage and track occupational health requirements for student enrollments within the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Update Occupational Health Details
steps: Invoke update function with new data

business_rules: Only allow edits if RowDisabled is false and user has access
Sort enrollments by LastName if not already sorted
validations: Check if UserSession is not null before proceeding
Ensure gridDataEdit row count is less than 14 to hide buttons
calculations: Determine button visibility based on read-only status and row counts
conditions: RowDisabled condition based on graduation or inactivity
system_behavior: Auto-generate UI controls for grid and panels
Use JavaScript to handle client-side interactions
exceptions: Cancel operations if UserSession is null
